summary: C8: post-launch telemetry review (model picker + cap)
description:
Post-launch operator chore. BRD §12 phase 3. After one week in
production, read the data and decide whether the curated list,
the cap, or both need adjustment.

No code change. Closing produces a short notes file (or comment
on the parent ticket) capturing what we learned.

Done when a short note covers:
  - Distribution of preferred_model across pro users (admin UI
    users-list filtering or one-shot SQL).
  - Distribution of cost_usd per pro user against the \$5 cap —
    histogram of monthly spend.
  - Number of users hitting usd_limit before query_limit (the
    'cap is binding' cohort).
  - Number of users hitting query_limit first (signals cap is too
    loose for actual usage).
  - sync-pricing timer journal — drift events caught vs no-op
    runs.
  - Recommendations: keep / bump cap / change curated list /
    change default. Each backed by a data point above.

Tests: none (review).

Operator action: SSH to VPS, run the SQL queries, write up the
notes. Estimated ~30 min of analysis a week post-launch.

Depends on: C1–C7 in production for ≥7 days.
